data: What is the word-level memory encoding method that performs best when using HMN-Word?

The question asks for the word-level memory encoding method that performs best when using HMN-Word. From the caption, we know that there are three word-level memory encoding methods: BiGRU, GRU, and Embedding. The figure shows three subfigures corresponding to HMN-Sent, HMN-Word, and HMN-Joint. We need to focus on the subfigure labeled (b) HMN-Word.

In the HMN-Word subfigure, we can see three lines representing the three word-level memory encoding methods: Embedding (cyan), GRU (blue), and BiGRU (red). The y-axis represents the number of predicted error samples, and the x-axis represents the value of k for the max pooling.

By examining the graph, we can observe that the Embedding line (cyan) consistently stays above the other two lines across all values of k. This indicates that the Embedding method performs better than the GRU and BiGRU methods when using HMN-Word.

Therefore, the word-level memory encoding method that performs best when using HMN-Word is **Embedding**.
